title: The 2025 derivation of $\alpha$ was circular, and a prediction needs a constitutive law

statements.text: Writing $\alpha = Z_0 / (2 R_K)$ is an exact metrological identity, not a prediction. Phase winding quantizes flux but does not fix the charge, so a genuine prediction of $\alpha$ needs an explicit constitutive law that fixes the electromagnetic response without importing the measured coupling.
